title: 七内天の立体構成研究 — 二構成の比較・折院共空への再設計・共晶三施設共有断面

validation.scope: Analytic 3D occupancy concept study with same-model diagnostic images; not a GLB/BLEND mesh submission.

shared_camera_comparisons.external_cameras: Identical across N1/N2/N3; ground perspective HFOV 58 degrees; orthographic horizontal span 10 km.
shared_camera_comparisons.internal_cameras: Model-specific near-floor eye; HFOV 82 degrees. N3 eye is exactly 2 m above flat ground-city floor.
shared_camera_comparisons.postprocessing: SVG rasterization with sharp; PNG palette 128 colors. No generative imagery.

checks_performed: Compared common-cavity N1 and serial-cavity N2 in the same analytic representation.
Stopped N1/N2 detail progression and redesigned main organization as N3 open civic court.
Recorded 200 m sampled material connectivity; refined only N2 to 100 m after small disconnected sample components.
Tested sightline occlusion at <=20 m spacing, camera-frame inclusion, and backing occupancy at +120 m in proposed gravity direction.
Probed four N3 600x240 m proposed surface patches at 21 points each.
Recorded N3 900 m material separation at one central section, not a global minimum.
Checked eight N3 urban-connection centerline segments.
C3 shared slab and wall removal each changed its cross-room test line from blocked to clear.
Checked six C3 shared-street centerline segments.
Inspected diagnostic sheets and retained unresolved side-wall, gate, and block-composition issues.
Computed exact SHA-256 checksums and byte sizes for all submitted artifacts.
limits: All geometric dimensions are concept parameters or numeric consequences, not verified measurements of a delivered mesh.
No actual residential districts or full public-building room groups modeled for the Seven Skies variants.
No completed city horizons; surface targets and sparse probes are not populated urban worlds.
No structural, physiological, pedestrian-floor, or minimum-thickness guarantee.
N3 east and north proposed patches lose backing at some civic openings.
N3 side/back still read as walls; no art-quality pass.
No Work use, heavy local production, GLB/BLEND export, or Minecraft construction.
G2 priority derives from user instruction; no separate G2 review artifact was present in inspected art/a baseline.

notes: N1/N2 are retained as stopped working configurations, not relabeled formal central REJECT. N3 resolves selected spatial conflicts but is not a recommended final art form; redesign of main city-bearing masses remains necessary. C3 establishes shared-boundary geometry only. G3 art review pending. Formal M247-C and construction remain HOLD.

provenance.g2_authority: Current human user instruction; prioritization only, not art acceptance.

execution.environment: Current local chat workspace, no Work handoff
execution.note: Small analytic occupancy calculations and diagnostic vector/raster sheets only; no mesh generation or heavy rendering.
